description.value: Lower Mount Erskine Nature Reserve is a protected natural area on Salt Spring Island managed by the Islands Trust, preserving forest and ecological habitat on the lower slopes of Mount Erskine. The reserve forms part of a broader conservation corridor on one of BC's most popular Gulf Islands cycling destinations. Touring cyclists riding Salt Spring Island's hilly roads may find the reserve a rewarding natural waypoint, though visitor infrastructure details are unconfirmed.
